comments.text: Cut the long ending of this sentence.
comments.quote: Welcome to Maple Court. We are delighted that you have decided to join our community, and we hope that you will feel at home here very quickly.
Trash and recycling are collected every Tuesday morning, and bins should be placed at the curb by seven o'clock in the evening before pickup, so that the crew can reach them.
If you have any questions about the building, you should contact the front office, which is open on weekdays from nine until five.

overall_note: Call the front office the Welcome Desk everywhere.

result.summary: Renamed the front office to Welcome Desk, trimmed two sentences, warmed one.
